pages.text: These commands are mainly for server owners, test worlds, and development setups. Normal survival progression does not depend on them.$(br2)All commands begin with $(thing)/ramessescurse$().

pages.title: Guilt Controls
pages.text: $(li)/ramessescurse guilt set <player> <value>$(li)/ramessescurse guilt add <player> <value>$(li)/ramessescurse guilt remove <player> <value>$(br2)Useful for validating the guilt bar, seal state, and purification costs.

pages.title: Locate & Cooldown
pages.text: $(li)/ramessescurse locate [player]$(li)/ramessescurse locate_tp [player] [index]$(li)/ramessescurse cooling duat [player]$(li)/ramessescurse cooling edict [player]$(br2)Useful for locating Satiety Crystals or resetting cooldowns during skill testing.
